title: Mount Teide & Masca Loop
difficulty: Moderate — winding mountain roads, some hairpin bends
startArea: Costa Adeje / Los Cristianos / Las Americas
description: The classic Tenerife road trip: from the south coast up through pine forests into Mount Teide National Park, then down the dramatic TF-436 to the cliffside village of Masca.

stops.name: Vilaflor
stops.description: Highest village in Tenerife, surrounded by pine forest. Good coffee stop.

stops.name: Mount Teide National Park
stops.description: Lunar landscapes around Spain's highest peak (3,715m). Stop at Roques de García viewpoint.
stops.tip: Cable car needs good weather and gets busy — go early or book ahead.

stops.name: Masca village
stops.description: Tiny village clinging to a ravine, once a hideout for pirates and smugglers. Spectacular viewpoint on the descent.

stops.name: Los Gigantes
stops.description: Towering cliffs dropping into the Atlantic — great spot for sunset on the way back.

title: South Coast Sunset Drive
startArea: Los Cristianos / Las Americas / Costa Adeje
description: A relaxed coastal cruise west along the TF-1 and TF-454, ending with one of the best sunsets on the island at Los Gigantes cliffs.

stops.name: Playa de la Arena
stops.description: Black sand beach near Puerto de Santiago, popular with locals.

stops.name: Puerto de Santiago
stops.description: Quiet fishing-village vibe with good seafood restaurants on the harbour.

stops.name: Los Gigantes
stops.description: 800m sea cliffs — walk the marina promenade for the best views, especially at golden hour.

stops.name: Acantilado de Guaza viewpoint (return)
stops.description: Quick stop on the way back for a panoramic view over Las Americas and the coastline.

title: Anaga Rainforest & La Laguna
distance: ~220 km round trip from the south
difficulty: Moderate-hard — long drive, narrow forest roads
startArea: Costa Adeje / Los Cristianos / Las Americas
description: A trip to the opposite end of the island: ancient laurel-forest mountains in the Anaga Rural Park, plus the UNESCO-listed colonial old town of La Laguna.

stops.name: San Cristóbal de La Laguna
stops.description: Tenerife's old capital — colourful colonial streets, UNESCO World Heritage centre.

stops.name: Cruz del Carmen viewpoint
stops.description: Gateway to Anaga, with sweeping views over the laurisilva (laurel) cloud forest.

stops.name: Taganana
stops.description: Remote village on the north coast with dramatic sea views and a famous rural church.

stops.name: Playa de Benijo
stops.description: Wild black-sand beach backed by jagged sea stacks — one of the island's most photographed spots.

highlights: Far fewer tourists than the south
